Growing and learning in a new position, a friendly environment… Sounds great, right! 😊 That’s what Samsung has to offer! If you become an assistant teamleader you’ll have lots of opportunities! You’ll start with a salary between €2700 and €3200 per month. It’s also a great job to combine with your social life. You will only work in dayshift and have your weekend off! What else could you want? 🤩

What we offer
- A starting salary between €2700 and €3200
- Working in dayshifts
- Working fulltime
- Lots of growing opportunities
- Travel allowance for every km: €0,23 per km
- Free weekends! 🤩

Who you are
To become an assistant teamleader, you’ll need to meet the following requirements:

- You have extensive experience in logistics in various departments;
- You are available full-time from Monday to Friday;
- You are available during the day shift: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM;
- You are good at working with people;
- You speak and understand English;
- You live near Samsung Tilburg (Tilburg West).

What will you do
You will start as an assistant teamleader on the outbound department at Samsung Tilburg. This means you will help your team on the work floor and manage them! In the outbound department all products are brought to the right location. This is done with an EPT, reachtruck or forklift. On outbound they also make sure products are ready for shipment. Put everything neatly on a pallet, seal and label everything. Great! Everything is running smoothly. If there’s a problem, you’ll make sure it gets resolved. You’ll also communicate with the teamleader. One thing is certain: your job will never be boring! 😉

Where will you work
You’re going to be working at Samsung in Tilburg. The warehouse is quite informal, so you’ll get to know your coworkers in no-time! Enjoy a fresh sandwich during lunchtime in the canteen. And if you like it: they sometimes organize something fun like a ping-pong tournament!

As a Maintenance & Growing Site Preparation Worker, you are responsible for maintaining and preparing our moss growing locations. In this role, you will work both indoors and outdoors, ensuring that all growing areas remain in excellent condition.

Your tasks include preparing new growing sites, carrying out maintenance work, and checking the quality and condition of the growing surfaces and facilities. You will also help keep the work environment clean, safe, and well-organized. Thanks to your efforts, our moss can grow under the best possible conditions, and our growing locations remain efficient and sustainable.

You will work 2 days per week (8 hours per day). You can choose which days you work, making this position ideal to combine with studies, another job, or other commitments.

- You enjoy working outdoors or have an interest in gardening or green spaces.
- You are available to work 2 days per week (8 hours per day).
- You have a good command of English or Dutch.
- You are practical and enjoy working with your hands.
- You are comfortable with physical work.

Do you want to be part of the coziest candy adventure in the Netherlands? Concorp in Waddinxveen has a great opportunity for you as a production employee! If you are a hardworking, motivated and passionate candy lover, then look no further, because we need you!

What are you going to do?

At this company, no day is the same. For example, one of your working days will look like this:

You come in and first grab a cup of coffee. The foreman distributes the production work and then everyone gets to work. Your tasks are diverse and varied. Sometimes you have to operate a machine, other times you stand at the assembly line and check the quality of products. Or you work in the warehouse: packing things and preparing them for shipment.

Together with your colleagues you make sure that all jobs are finished by the end of the day. Just make sure to clean up after and the job is done.

This job is a day shift and the working hours are from 07:00 to 15:00.

Waar ga je werken?

You will be working in the best candy factory in the Netherlands! Every day millions of candies race out of this factory. Well known candy brands such as Autodrop and Skittles are produced here.

It is a family business with now two factories in the Netherlands, including in Waddinxveen.

The company has an open and sincere corporate atmosphere. All employees feel connected and enjoy going to work together.

The company is easy to reach by car and by public transport. There is plenty of parking and it is within walking distance from the bus stop!

Wat vragen wij?

We are looking for someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and is not averse to working. And further:

- You are precise and can work well independently;
- It is important that you have at least basic knowledge of the Dutch and English language, both spoken and written;
- That you work neatly and ordered;
- That you can work well under high work pressure;
- Experience in production work is an advantage.
